links.outcome: Readability of LLM-simplified chest CT reports across models using five readability metrics
links.effect: GPT-3.5-Turbo had best overall readability, beating GPT-4 in two metrics; Llama-3-70b beat GPT-3.5-Turbo on CLI (p = 0.006); Claude-3-Opus and Gemini-Ultra scored lower on readability.
links.quote: GPT-3.5-Turbo showed the best overall readability, outperforming GPT-4 in two metrics.

links.outcome: Emotional sensitivity of LLM-generated patient-friendly reports rated by radiologists
links.effect: Claude-3-Opus and GPT-4 outperformed Llama-3-70b in emotional sensitivity (90.0 % vs 46.0 %, p < 0.001).
links.quote: Claude-3-Opus and GPT-4 outperformed Llama-3-70b in emotional sensitivity (90.0 % vs 46.0 %, p < 0.001).

unlisted_practices: Comparing open-source versus proprietary LLMs for patient-friendly radiology report generation

screen.reason: Empirical study comparing seven proprietary and open-source LLMs on their ability to simplify chest CT radiology reports into patient-friendly language, evaluated using readability metrics and radiologist ratings.
